INTAKE_REVIEW.conclusion: No newly introduced dropped request found in legal executor job sequences by static inspection. This is not a dynamic test pass. A separate adversarial simulation reproduced the preexisting capture-write conflict in both baseline and candidate; this does not change the current-executor reachability conclusion.

checks.conclusion: Executor retains batch mode from ISSUE through WAIT until all externally accepted responses are consumed; no pending request remains on legal mode exit.
Pending tag is reserved before context busy; refill of a retiring different tag writes new context no earlier than the next clock.
Coordinates and request controls are registered at reception; public seed/identifier/node size remain covered by the existing stable-job-input contract.
stage_fixed is carried with valid/tag and recycle; invalid stages mask uninitialized type bits.

existing_boundary.description: Direct recipe batch API with XMSS shape8 paired requests and capture enabled can align prior FINAL capture_now and next request right_write on one edge. captured single write port prioritizes right_write, potentially leaving the old captured slot unchanged while captured_valid is asserted.
existing_boundary.unreachability_reason: Executor emits shape8 only for lt_pipe, and explicitly disables batch_capture_enable whenever lt_pipe is true. Scalar requests are serialized.
existing_boundary.possible_fix_not_applied: Block internal ctx_request_ready when capture_now && ctx_request_pair && ctx_request_fixed_shape == 8; wait one cycle.
